study_label: POST-HOC ASSUMPTION AUDIT (not pre-registered discovery research)
trigger: FLOW 1B exploratory (NOT pre-registered) finding: log(RV20) had negative T+10 partial IC controlling Technical (-0.034 [-0.047, -0.022]) in the discovery 100. Exploratory findings alone cannot justify a methodology change; this audit tests the specific production assumption on the external universe.

production_assumption_under_audit.definition: relative_volume_series(volume, 20) = V_T / rolling_median(V, 20) with the window INCLUDING session T (app/engines/technical/relative_volume.py); single-session ratio at T.
production_assumption_under_audit.classes: LOW < 0.5 <= NORMAL < 1.5 <= HIGH < 2.5 <= VERY_HIGH; NaN -> UNKNOWN (classify_relative_volume, DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS)
production_assumption_under_audit.only_behavioral_use: classify_signal: STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION requires score>=40 AND UPTREND AND confirmed not-broken BULLISH breakout AND high_volume AND MTF aligned UP. Without high volume the same state becomes BULLISH_CONFIRMED. Downstream: fcm_sender new-opportunity push notification requires STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION; horizon_classifier maps STRONG to KISA_VADELI (horizon hidden in UI since HATA 8C).

never_exposed: absolute return level of any Technical or signal-class group
allowed: high-volume minus not-high-volume deltas within the SAME Technical state

data.universe: FLOW 1C external universe (484 symbols; flow_v1c_universe.json sha a98aa034...; zero overlap with FLOW 1B 100; verified by FLOW 1C-R1)
data.dataset: existing local FLOW 1C frozen snapshot, dataset_sha256 2dddfc3d8525abc0fb05cd2047f972db878ddec67f5dac5b6edd3af930a934b1; no new fetch
data.limitations: Yahoo back-adjusted data (not point-in-time); current-listing survivorship; same calendar period as discovery.

production_exact_state_reconstruction.method: For every (symbol, completed session T): df = contiguous-segment bars with date >= T - 6 calendar months (production ANALYSIS_WINDOW_MONTHS), ending at T; app.engines.technical.engine.compute_technical_analysis(df, ..., frozen V1 weights, benchmark_close_series = frozen XU100, now = T 18:45 Europe/Istanbul). The SignalInputs passed to classify_signal are captured in the research process (runtime wrapper, production code untouched).
production_exact_state_reconstruction.eligibility: the segment must contain at least one bar dated before T - 6 months (production VERIFIED_PRE_WINDOW analogue; leading-edge / new-listing windows excluded) and len(df) >= MIN_HISTORY_DAYS (60). No fill; gaps split segments.

derived_fields.rv20: production relative volume ratio at T
derived_fields.high_volume: rv20 >= 1.5; not_high: rv20 < 1.5; rv20 NaN -> excluded
derived_fields.bullish_confirmed_breakout: captured breakout_event is BULLISH and confirmed is True
derived_fields.strong_preconditions_without_volume: classify_signal(captured inputs with relative_volume_class forced to HIGH) == STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION, evaluated with the UNWRAPPED production classify_signal. Equivalent to: score>=40 AND UPTREND AND BULLISH breakout confirmed AND retest not failed AND MTF aligned UP. high_volume is NOT part of the predicate (invariant to the input relative_volume_class).

production_exact_state_reconstruction.capture_isolation: ProcessPoolExecutor worker processes (no threads); the wrapper is installed only in each worker's initializer; each worker runs tasks sequentially and clears its own capture dict before every call; the main process is never patched. Per-symbol checkpoints make the build resumable; content is order-independent (rows sorted by date, symbol).
production_exact_state_reconstruction.semantic_verification: Fail-fast before analysis: every row with strong_preconditions_without_volume=TRUE has final class STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION iff rv20>=1.5 and BULLISH_CONFIRMED otherwise (rv20 NaN -> BULLISH_CONFIRMED); every STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION row has the predicate TRUE and rv20>=1.5.

targets.return: Close(T)->Close(T+h) minus XU100 over the same dates (FLOW panel ex_h; information target, not tradable price)

definitions.price_direction_T: r_T = Close_T / Close_{T-1} - 1 (one-session change, same semantics as market_data/changes '1d'); up if r_T > +0.005, down if r_T < -0.005, flat otherwise
definitions.spike_vs_sustained: among high-volume T: SPIKE if none of T-4..T-1 is high-volume; SUSTAINED if at least 2 of T-4..T-1 are high-volume (production-identical rv20 per session)
definitions.low_liquidity: bottom cross-sectional quintile of median 20-session Close*Volume on date T
definitions.min_group: per date >= 2 observations in each compared group
definitions.date_balanced_delta: delta_d = mean(target | group) - mean(target | comparison) on date d; statistic = mean over dates

primary.name: PRIMARY
primary.statement: Among states with strong_preconditions_without_volume = TRUE (and rv20 available): A = high_volume TRUE (final STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION) minus B = high_volume FALSE (final BULLISH_CONFIRMED), T+10 XU100-relative return, date-balanced (>= 2 per group per date).
primary.conditioning_rule: Conditioning uses ONLY the volume-independent predicate. Final signal_class is never a conditioning or matching variable.
primary.also_reported: hit-rate delta (pp), observations per group, date count
primary.uncertainty: circular block bootstrap over dates, block 20, 10000 replicates, seed 12001, two-sided 95% CI; Newey-West t (lag 10)

key_diagnostic.name: KEY_DIAGNOSTIC
key_diagnostic.statement: Mean over dates of cross-sectional rank semi-partial IC of log(rv20) controlling rank(technical_score_prod), T+10, min 20 assets per date (FLOW method). Diagnostic, not a strategy.

secondary_family.correction: Holm across the whole secondary family; no secondary result enters the classification except where explicitly named below
members: PRIMARY (STRONG A/B) at T+1, T+5, T+20
TECHNICAL_POSITIVE_CONTEXT: within technical_score_prod >= 15, high minus not-high, T+10 (the V1 primary, demoted)
BEARISH: within Technical-negative, high minus not-high, T+10
NEUTRAL: within Technical-neutral, high minus not-high, T+10
BREAKOUT_CONTEXT: among bullish_confirmed_breakout states (any score), high minus not-high, T+10
DIRECTION A-B / C-D / E-F (unchanged from V1)
SPIKE / SUSTAINED: within the PRIMARY context, spike-high (resp. sustained-high) minus not-high
LIQUIDITY: PRIMARY and TECHNICAL_POSITIVE_CONTEXT within the lowest-liquidity quintile and within the remaining 80%
LIMIT_LOCKED: PRIMARY and TECHNICAL_POSITIVE_CONTEXT excluding H==L sessions

stability: PRIMARY delta by calendar year and by market regime (XU100 trailing 20-session return > 0 vs <= 0). Descriptive.

applies_to: PRIMARY context: selected = high-volume (STRONG) vs all strong_preconditions_without_volume states
TECHNICAL_POSITIVE_CONTEXT: selected = high-volume vs all Technical-positive
ten_offset.rule: offsets 0..9 of the eligible-date sequence, every 10th date, T+10; each offset reported; mean, median, min, max, number with the same sign as the all-dates overlapping estimate; no offset selected
ten_offset.costs: net = (mean(selected) - c*turnover_selected) - (mean(all) - c*turnover_all), c in {10, 20, 40} bps round-trip

classification_rule.DIRECTION-CONDITIONAL: PRIMARY 95% CI_low > 0 AND BEARISH delta Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 with negative sign
classification_rule.REDUNDANT: PRIMARY 95% CI within [-0.0025, +0.0025] AND KEY_DIAGNOSTIC 95% CI within [-0.01, +0.01]
classification_rule.production_change_indicated: HARMFUL or DIRECTION-CONDITIONAL -> EVET (recommend separate fix ticket; NO change here); SUPPORTED or REDUNDANT -> HAYIR; INCONCLUSIVE -> BELIRSIZ. PRODUCTION_STRONG_CONTEXT is reported alongside because it is the exact production use, but it cannot override the classification.

no_production_change: TechnicalAnalysisEngine, signal_classifier, weights, confidence, breakout logic, notifications and DecisionEngine are NOT modified in this ticket regardless of outcome.
no_post_hoc_rule: Definitions, thresholds, horizons, groups, correction and classification rule may not change after outcomes are seen; any change creates TECH_VOL_1A_AUDIT_PROTOCOL_V3.

supersedes.reason: User decision before ANY outcome was computed (the V1 state build crashed with BrokenProcessPool and produced no data): the PRIMARY must test the exact production use of the flag — within states that satisfy every STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION condition except high_volume, compare high_volume=True (final STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION) with high_volume=False (final BULLISH_CONFIRMED). Final signal_class is never used as a conditioning/matching variable (it is deterministically changed by high_volume; conditioning on it would be collider/selection bias). Thresholds, definitions, horizons, correction and classification rule are unchanged; only primary/secondary roles moved.
